Quantity.name: Quantity
Quantity.definition: Quantity of entitled intermediate securities based on the balance of underlying securities.

RenounceableEntitlementStatusType.name: Renounceable Entitlement Status Type
RenounceableEntitlementStatusType.definition: Specifies whether terms of the event allow resale of the rights.

FractionDisposition.name: Fraction Disposition
FractionDisposition.definition: Specifies how fractions resulting from derived securities will be processed or how prorated decisions will be rounding, if provided with a pro ration rate.

IntermediateSecuritiesToUnderlyingRatio.name: Intermediate Securities To Underlying Ratio
IntermediateSecuritiesToUnderlyingRatio.definition: Quantity of intermediate securities awarded for a given quantity of underlying security.

MarketPrice.name: Market Price
MarketPrice.definition: Last reported/known price of a financial instrument in a market.

ExpiryDate.name: Expiry Date
ExpiryDate.definition: Date on which an order expires or at which a privilege or offer terminates.

PostingDate.name: Posting Date
PostingDate.definition: Date of the posting (credit or debit) to the account.

TradingPeriod.name: Trading Period
TradingPeriod.definition: Period during which intermediate or outturn securities are tradable in a secondary market.
